correctness.rationale: The full proof derives the projection–subalgebra equivalence, classifies subalgebras by center membership, excludes two noncentral summands by the symplectic isotropic dimension bound, and multiplies isotropic-frame, complement, and graph-functional counts. The exact exponent E=4ns-(5s²-3s)/2 and product bounds yield log_q total=(8/5)n²+(6/5)n+O_q(1) and five total-variation profiles by dominated convergence. Standalone verify.py independently enumerated all subalgebra complements for (n,q)=(1,2),(1,3),(2,2); all 2^9 and 3^9 matrices in dimension three were checked directly for P²=P and the Rota–Baxter identity. All outputs matched. Finite checks do not claim to prove the theorem for all n,q.

value.rationale: The operator class is a canonical structural invariant of the Lie algebra: idempotent weight-minus-one Rota–Baxter maps are equivalent to ordered Lie-subalgebra factorizations. The complete rank polynomial in every finite characteristic and its nontrivial two-packet, five-phase bounded-fluctuation limits constitute a meaningful natural invariant and a structural phenomenon beyond routine counting of arbitrary subspaces.
